description.value: Roxy Burger is a locally owned and operated full-service restaurant on Granville Street in Vancouver's entertainment district, serving generous portions of comfort food anchored by a broad menu of made-to-order burgers using Certified Angus Beef. The venue doubles as a late-night sports bar with daily live sports and events, and offers both indoor and outdoor seating. It's a practical refuelling stop for cyclists moving through downtown, with online ordering available.
